questions.question: Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number. 13 ∶ 4 ∶∶ 19 ∶ ? ∶∶ 16 ∶ 5

13 ∶  4 ∶∶ 19 ∶ ? ∶∶ 16 ∶ 5
questions.solution:
Given that,

13 ∶  4 ∶∶ 19 ∶ ? ∶∶ 16 ∶ 5

For 13 : 4 → 4 × 3 + 1 = 12 + 1 = 13

For 16 : 5 → 5 × 3 + 1 = 15 + 1 = 16

Similarly, 

For 19 : ? 

? × 3 + 1 = 19

? × 3 = 19 - 1 = 18

? = 18 / 3 = 6

Hence, "6" is the correct answer.

Alternate Method

13 ∶  4 ∶∶ 19 ∶ ? ∶∶ 16 ∶ 5First number added with 6 and get first number of second term and first number of second term subtracted half of 6 (i.e. 3) and get first number of third term.

13 + 6 = 19, 19 - \(\frac{6}{2}\) = 19 - 3 = 16

Similarly, second number added with 2 and get second number of second term and second number of second term subtracted half of 2 (i.e. 1) and get second number of third term.

4 + 2 = 6, 6 - \(\frac{2}{2}\) = 6 - 1 = 5

We get -

13 ∶  4 ∶∶ 19 ∶ 6 ∶∶ 16 ∶ 5

Hence, "6" is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a training camp, three types of games hockey, cricket and badminton were taught. 14% of the total students received cricket training. 22% of the remaining students received training for hockey. Half of the remaining students received training for badminton. What percentage of students did NOT receive training in any of the three games?
questions.questionHtml: In a training camp, three types of games hockey, cricket and badminton were taught. 14% of the total students received cricket training. 22% of the remaining students received training for hockey. Half of the remaining students received training for badminton. What percentage of students did NOT receive training in any of the three games?
questions.solution:
Given:

In a training camp, three types of games hockey, cricket, and badminton were taught.

14% of the total students received cricket training.

Calculation:

Remaining students = (100 - 14)% = 86% 

22% of the remaining students received training for hockey.

Percentage of students who received training for hockey = 22/100 × 86 = 18.92%

Remaining students = (86 - 18.92)% = 67.08%

Half of the remaining students received training for badminton.

Percentage of students who received training for badminton = 50/100 × 67.08 = 33.54%

Percentage of students who did NOT receive training in any of the three games = 100 - (14 + 18.92 + 33.54) = 100 - 66.46 = 33.54%

Hence, ‘33.54%’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: A train is to cover 370 km at a uniform speed. After running 100 km, the train could run at a speed 5 km/h less than its normal speed due to some technical fault. The train got delayed by 36 minutes. What is the normal speed of the train, in km/h?
questions.questionHtml: A train is to cover 370 km at a uniform speed. After running 100 km, the train could run at a speed 5 km/h less than its normal speed due to some technical fault. The train got delayed by 36 minutes. What is the normal speed of the train, in km/h?
questions.solution:
Given:

Distance covered by the train = 370 km 

Formula used:

Time = Distance/Speed

Calculation:

Let the speed of the train = x km/h

As per the question;

[100/x + 270/(x - 5)] - 370/x = 36/60 

⇒270/(x - 5) - 270/x = 3/5

⇒ 1/(x - 5) - 1/x = 1/450

⇒ [x - (x - 5)]/(x - 5)x = 1/450

⇒ 5/(x - 5)x = 1/450

⇒  5 × 450 = x2 - 5x 

⇒ x2 - 5x - 2250 = 0

⇒x2 - 50x + 45x - 2250 = 0 

⇒ x(x - 50) + 45(x - 50) = 0

⇒ (x + 45)(x - 50) = 0

⇒ x ≠ 45, x = 50

∴ The required speed of the train = 50 km/h

Alternate MethodBy Hit and Trial Method:

[100/x + 270/(x - 5)] - 370/x = 36/60

Option 1: [100/40 + 270/(35)] - 370/40 ≠  36/60

Option 2: [100/45 + 270/(40)] - 370/45 ≠  36/60

Option 3: [100/50 + 270/(45)] - 370/50 = 36/60

Option 4: [100/48 + 270/(43)] - 370/48 ≠  36/60

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks his goods 30% higher than the cost price and allows a discount of 10% on the marked price. In order to earn 6.5% more profit, what discount percent should he allow on the marked price?
questions.questionHtml: A shopkeeper marks his goods 30% higher than the cost price and allows a discount of 10% on the marked price. In order to earn 6.5% more profit, what discount percent should he allow on the marked price?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Initial Profit% = 30 − 10 − (30 × 10 ÷ 100) = 17%.

New required Profit% = 17 + 6.5 = 23.5%.

Let new discount be d%. Using effective change formula: 30 − d − (30d ÷ 100) = 23.5.

6.5 = 1.3d ⇒ d = 6.5 ÷ 1.3 = 5%.

∴ The correct answer is 5%.

Alternate Method

Given: Markup = 30%, Initial Discount = 10%, Additional Profit required = 6.5%.

Formulas: SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100 | MP = CP × (100 + Markup%) ÷ 100 | Discount% = (MP − SP) ÷ MP × 100

⇒ Let CP = 100. Then Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 30% of 100 = 130.

⇒ Initial Selling Price (SP) = 130 − 10% of 130 = 130 − 13 = 117.

⇒ Initial Profit = 117 − 100 = 17.

⇒ New Profit required = 17 + 6.5 = 23.5. New SP = 100 + 23.5 = 123.5.

⇒ New Discount Amount = MP − New SP = 130 − 123.5 = 6.5.

⇒ New Discount Percent = (6.5 ÷ 130) × 100 = 5%.

∴ The correct answer is 5%.

Additional Information

Markup and Discount Relation

The relationship between Cost Price and Marked Price can be expressed as: MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit%) ÷ (100 − Discount%).

Effective Profit Percentage

When a markup of m% and a discount of d% are applied, the Net Profit% = m − d − (md ÷ 100).

questions.question: The area of a circular park is 12474 m 2 . There is 3.5 m wide path around the park. What is the area (in m 2 ) of the path? (Take π = \(\rm \frac{22}{7}\) )

questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

For a path of width (w) around a circle, Path Area = πw(2r + w).

Path Area = (22/7) × 3.5 × (2 × 63 + 3.5) = 11 × 129.5 = 1424.5 m2.

∴ The correct answer is 1424.5 m2.

Alternate Method

Given:

Width of the path (w) = 3.5 m

Formula Used:

Area of circle = πr2

Area of path = πR2 − πr2 = π(R2 − r2)

Calculations:

⇒ πr2 = 12474

⇒ (22/7) × r2 = 12474

⇒ r2 = (12474 × 7) / 22 = 567 × 7 = 3969

⇒ r = √3969 = 63 m

⇒ Outer radius (R) = r + width = 63 + 3.5 = 66.5 m

⇒ Area of Path = π(R2 − r2) = π(R + r)(R − r)

⇒ Area of Path = (22/7) × (66.5 + 63) × (66.5 − 63)

⇒ Area of Path = (22/7) × 129.5 × 3.5

⇒ Area of Path = 22 × 129.5 × 0.5 = 11 × 129.5 = 1424.5 m2

∴ The correct answer is 1424.5 m2.

Additional Information

Area of Annulus (Ring)

The region between two concentric circles is called an annulus. Its area is given by π(R2 − r2), where R is the outer radius and r is the inner radius.

Circumference of Circle

The total boundary length of a circle is calculated as 2πr, where r is the radius of the circle.

Relation between Radius and Area

If the radius of a circle is multiplied by a factor 'k', then its Area is multiplied by k2 and its Circumference is multiplied by k.

∴ (x - 1/x) = 5

questions.question: The average of eleven numbers is 56. The average of first three numbers is 52 and that of next five numbers is 60. The 9th and 10th number are 3 and 1 more than the 11th number respectively. What is the average of 9th and 11th numbers?
questions.questionHtml: The average of eleven numbers is 56. The average of first three numbers is 52 and that of next five numbers is 60. The 9th and 10th number are 3 and 1 more than the 11th number respectively. What is the average of 9th and 11th numbers?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Net deviation from the overall average (56) = 3 × (52 − 56) + 5 × (60 − 56) = −12 + 20 = +8.

To balance the average, the deviation of the last 3 numbers must be −8. Thus, their total sum = 3 × 56 − 8 = 160.

Let the 11th number be x. Then, 9th number = x + 3 and 10th number = x + 1.

Sum = x + 3 + x + 1 + x = 160 ⇒ 3x = 156 ⇒ x = 52.

The average of the 9th and 11th numbers = (x + 3 + x) ÷ 2 = x + 1.5 = 52 + 1.5 = 53.5.

∴ The correct answer is 53.5.

Alternate Method

Given:

Average of 11 numbers = 56

Average of first 3 numbers = 52

Average of next 5 numbers = 60

Let the 11th number = x. Then the 9th number = x + 3 and the 10th number = x + 1.

Calculations:

⇒ Sum of all 11 numbers = 11 × 56 = 616

⇒ Sum of first 3 numbers = 3 × 52 = 156

⇒ Sum of next 5 numbers = 5 × 60 = 300

⇒ Sum of the 9th, 10th, and 11th numbers = Total sum − (Sum of first 3 + Sum of next 5)

⇒ Sum of the last 3 numbers = 616 − (156 + 300) = 616 − 456 = 160

⇒ (x + 3) + (x + 1) + x = 160

⇒ 3x + 4 = 160

⇒ 3x = 156

⇒ x = 52

⇒ 11th number = 52

⇒ 9th number = 52 + 3 = 55

⇒ Average of 9th and 11th numbers = (55 + 52) ÷ 2 = 107 ÷ 2 = 53.5

∴ The correct answer is 53.5.

Additional Information

Sum of Observations

The total sum of any set of observations is simply the average multiplied by the number of observations (Sum = Average × N).

Net Deviation Method

The sum of all deviations of the individual values from their arithmetic mean is always zero. This property helps significantly in breaking down complex averages without multiplying large numbers.

Combined Average

When multiple groups are combined, their total average is given by (N1A1 + N2A2 + N3A3) ÷ (N1 + N2 + N3).

questions.question: The value of \(\rm \frac{tan(45°-\alpha)}{cot(45°+\alpha)}-\frac{(cos19°+sin71°)(sec19°+cosec71°)}{tan 12° tan 24° tan 66° tan 78°}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: The value of \(\rm \frac{tan(45°-\alpha)}{cot(45°+\alpha)}-\frac{(cos19°+sin71°)(sec19°+cosec71°)}{tan 12° tan 24° tan 66° tan 78°}\) is:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Identify complementary angles: tan(45° − α) = cot(45° + α), so the first term is 1.

Simplify numerator: (cos 19° + cos 19°)(sec 19° + sec 19°) = 2 cos 19° × 2 sec 19° = 4.

Simplify denominator: tan 12° × tan 78° = 1 and tan 24° × tan 66° = 1.

Final calculation: 1 − (4 ÷ 1) = −3.

∴ The correct answer is -3.

Alternate Method

Given: Expression involving trigonometric ratios of complementary angles.

Formula Used: tan(90° − θ) = cot θ | sin(90° − θ) = cos θ | sec(90° − θ) = cosec θ | tan θ × cot θ = 1

Step-by-step Calculations:

⇒ cot(45° + α) = tan(90° − (45° + α)) = tan(45° − α)

⇒ Part 1: tan(45° − α) ÷ tan(45° − α) = 1

⇒ sin 71° = cos(90° − 71°) = cos 19° and cosec 71° = sec(90° − 71°) = sec 19°

⇒ Numerator of Part 2: (cos 19° + cos 19°)(sec 19° + sec 19°) = (2 cos 19°)(2 sec 19°) = 4(cos 19° × sec 19°) = 4 × 1 = 4

⇒ tan 78° = cot 12° and tan 66° = cot 24°

⇒ Denominator of Part 2: (tan 12° × cot 12°) × (tan 24° × cot 24°) = 1 × 1 = 1

⇒ Final Value: 1 − (4 ÷ 1) = 1 − 4 = −3

∴ The correct answer is -3.

Additional Information

Complementary Angles in Trigonometry

If A + B = 90°, then sin A = cos B, tan A = cot B, and sec A = cosec B.

Product of Tangents

When A + B = 90°, tan A × tan B = 1 because tan B = cot A.

Reciprocal Relations

Trigonometric identities include sin θ × cosec θ = 1, cos θ × sec θ = 1, and tan θ × cot θ = 1.

Total work = Time × Efficiency

questions.question: Find the greatest value of b so that 30a68b (a > b) is divisible by 11.
questions.questionHtml: Find the greatest value of b so that 30a68b (a > b) is divisible by 11.
questions.solution:
Given:

30a68b (a > b) is divisible by 11

Concept:

If the difference between the sum of the digits at the odd and even places equal 0 or divisible by 11, the number is divisible by 11.

Calculation:

(3 + a + 8) - (0 + 6 + b) = 0 or 11

⇒ 11 + a - 6 - b = 0 or 11

⇒ 5 + a - b = 0 or 11

⇒ 5 + a - b ≠  0  [a > b]

Let 5 + a - b = 11 

⇒ a - b = 6 

⇒ For a = 9, b = 3      ∵  [a > b]

⇒ 9 - 3 = 6

∴ The greatest value of b is 3, when 30a68b (a > b) is divisible by 11.

Mistake PointsDon't get confused about the value of 'b'.

We need to look at the 'boundary condition' given in the question i.e. a > b

Thus, b cannot be more than a.

questions.question: Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. When he reached his town, he went to his house and knocked at the door. B. A man went away from his home. C. Disappointed, he decided to take it himself. D. One day he wrote a letter to his family, but could not find anyone to take the letter to his town.
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. When he reached his town, he went to his house and knocked at the door.

B. A man went away from his home.

C. Disappointed, he decided to take it himself.

D. One day he wrote a letter to his family, but could not find anyone to take the letter to his town.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BDCA'.

Key Points

  • The sentence 'B' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "a man". Hence, 'B' is the first part.
  • Sentence D will come after B because it explains what the man decided to do after he went away from home and whether he succeeded in it or not.
  • Sentence C will come after D because it explains how the man reacted after he failed to send the letter to his family.
  • The sentence 'A' is the concluding part because it explains what the man finally decided to do.
     

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences: A man went away from his home. One day he wrote a letter to his family, but could not find anyone to take the letter to his town. Disappointed, he decided to take it himself. When he reached his town, he went to his house and knocked at the door.

Additional Information 

  • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:
    • Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
    • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
    • Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
       

Hinglish

  • वाक्य 'B' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "एक आदमी" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'B' पहला भाग है।
  • वाक्य D, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि घर से चले जाने के बाद आदमी ने क्या करने का फैसला किया और वह उसमें सफल हुआ या नहीं।
  • वाक्य C, D के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि अपने परिवार को पत्र भेजने में विफल रहने के बाद आदमी ने कैसे प्रतिक्रिया दी।
  • वाक्य 'A' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह बताता है कि आदमी ने आखिरकार क्या करने का फैसला किया।

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Deepa's mother told her to read the instructions before she started making the dish.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is a direct speech.
  • The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
    • The commas, inverted commas are removed.
    • In indirect speech, we need to always use 'told' - when there is an object (here, 'her').
    • Many reporting verbs can be followed by another verb in either an infinitive (here, to read) or an -ing form.
    • The second-person pronoun 'you' becomes the third-person pronoun 'she'.
    • The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (start) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (started) + Object'.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Confusion Points

  • You may think reporting verb ''had made'' should be used. 
  • Option 4 is wrong because 'has' is used in the perfect tense of the indirect speech.
  • Thus, the correct answer is option 1.
     

Additional Information

  • The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-
    Direct Speech Indirect Speech
    Present simple (Subject +V1st + Object) Past simple (Subject +V2 + Object)
    Present continuous (Subject +is/am/are+V1 +ing+ Object) Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1 +ing+ Object)
    Present perfect (Subject + has/have+V3+Object) Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
    Past simple (Subject+V2+Object) Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
    Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1+ing+ Object) Past perfect continuous (Subject+had been+V1 +ing+ Object)

Key Points

  • In Active voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
  • In Passive voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
  • The given sentence is an imperative sentence in the active voice.
  • In imperative sentences (which contains an order) where there is no object, 'Let' is used.
  • For Example:-
    • Active Voice - Open the door.
    • Passive Voice - Let the door be opened.
  • An imperative sentence in the passive voice has the following form: Let + object (all the windows) + be + past participle (closed).
  • This is the active and passive voice rule for the present simple tense.
     

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Past Perfect Continuous He had been playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual

  • Passive voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
  • दिया गया वाक्य active voice में एक imperative sentence है।
  • Imperative sentence में (जिसमें एक आदेश होता है) जहां कोई वस्तु नहीं है, 'Let' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
  • उदाहरण के लिए:-
    • Active Voice - Open the door.
    • Passive Voice - Let the door be opened.
  • Passive voice में एक imperative sentence का निम्न रूप है: Let + object (all the windows) + be + past participle (closed)।

questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. At length the olive tree's branches broke with the snow's weight, at once despoiling it of its beauty and killing the tree.

B. A shower of snow fell upon them and, finding the Olive full of foliage, it settled upon its branches.

C. Finding the fig tree without leaves, the snow fell through the branches to the ground and did not injure it at all.

D. The olive tree ridiculed the fig tree because, while she was green all year round, the fig tree changed its leaves with the seasons.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DBAC'.

Key Points

  • The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "the olive tree and the fig tree". Hence, 'D' is the first part.
  • Sentence B will come after D because it explains what happens when a shower of snow fell upon the branches of the olive tree.
  • Sentence A will come after B because it explains what happens to the branches of the olive tree due to the weight of the snow.
  • The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it explains on the other hand what happens with the fig tree when the snow fell upon it.
     

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences: The olive tree ridiculed the fig tree because, while she was green all year round, the fig tree changed its leaves with the seasons. A shower of snow fell upon them and, finding the Olive full of foliage, it settled upon its branches. At length the olive tree's branches broke with the snow's weight, at once despoiling it of its beauty and killing the tree. Finding the fig tree without leaves, the snow fell through the branches to the ground and did not injure it at all.

Hint

  • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:
    • Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
    • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
    • Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
       

Hinglish

  • वाक्य 'D' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "जैतून के पेड़ और अंजीर के पेड़" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'D' पहला भाग है।
  • वाक्य B, D के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि जब जैतून के पेड़ की शाखाओं पर बर्फ की बौछार गिरती है तो क्या होता है।
  • वाक्य A, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि बर्फ के भार के कारण जैतून के पेड़ की शाखाओं का क्या होता है।
  • वाक्य 'C' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह दूसरी ओर बताता है कि जब बर्फ गिरती है तो अंजीर के पेड़ के साथ क्या होता है।
